changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led inbound sales proposal with two required Crews, optional account research, validated draft handoffs, and a manual first run.

title: Inbound Lead-to-Meeting Review
description: Qualify an inbound enquiry, optionally research its account, and prepare an owner-reviewed follow-up that can be tracked through a booked meeting.
setup_prompt: Use Inbound Lead-to-Meeting Review as a proposal. Inspect the current Automation, existing Crews, lead sources, qualification rules, contact policy, and past outreach before proposing changes. Reuse suitable Crews or propose Lead Intake & Qualifier and Sales Follow-up Coordinator; add Account Researcher only when deeper research helps. Show the exact source, access, artifact handoffs, validator steps, owner review, and bounded first manual run. After I review the concrete proposal, configure it through Builder tools and verify it. Selecting this Playbook alone does not create Crews, contact a lead, update CRM, book a meeting, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized inbound lead source or export
Offer, target buyer, fit and routing criteria
Lead owner and review decision maker
Contact, suppression, approval, and duplicate rules
Useful meeting definition, source, and baseline decision
Manual-only or reviewed cadence and timezone

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing sales specialist with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass only a validated bounded lead or research artifact to the next authorized Crew

recommended_tools.name: CRM or form export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current inbound requests, owner and prior-contact state from an authorized source

recommended_tools.name: CRM, email, or calendar connection
recommended_tools.purpose: Support separately approved delivery and actual meeting outcome tracking

pulse_focus.label: Qualified conversations
focus_areas: Whether reviewed follow-ups address the buyer's actual request
Whether qualified leads become useful meetings without duplicate or blocked contact
review_when: Qualification policy changes, a lead replies, a meeting is booked, or source freshness fails

outputs: Reviewed sales Crew roster and source map
Owner-reviewed follow-up draft and action ledger
Manual route evidence and meeting-measurement policy
